conceptZh: 玩具機器人用力過猛，衝過頭，小鴨被撞得轉圈，第二次輕輕一推才讓鴨字站好。
object: a boxy mismatched toy robot and a rubber duck
morph: a robot overshoots, skids back, and the gentle second push settles the strokes of 鴨
creativeAngle: 過頭再輕輕：長短手機器人學會輕推。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale sunny blue background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 鴨 as the only text on screen, drawn in butter-orange solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts, with one very long arm, charges at a floating rubber duck and shoots past it, the first 鴨 spoken as the left 甲 shape clangs in at the left. 1.7-3.4s: he skids back on his treads with sparks of confetti and bonks the duck so it spins like a top; the second 鴨 is spoken as the right 鳥 strokes drop in after the duck's spin slows. 3.4-5s: he tries again with only a fingertip nudge, and 小鴨 is spoken as the duck squeaks, bobs on a puddle, and blows one small bubble that floats up. 5-8s: hold; the robot's long arm waves and the duck paddles in a little circle, glyph still. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "鴨、鴨、小鴨" (ㄧㄚ、ㄧㄚ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄧㄚ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 鴨 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
